nom: ANUA PDRN Collagen Melting Patch For Neck

avis.texte: Messed up my skin people said for acne pron skin IT IS NOT it broke my skin out bad and its just a waste of money

avis.titre: Just a melting piece of paper
avis.texte: I dont know why these are so heavily influenced online. I thought it was going to be an acutal mask like a sheet or jelly that would at least add hydration. Its just a piece of paper that disolves and and doesnt leave skin feeling moisturized even.
